updates.note: Management lowered consolidated revenue guidance to INR 4,100 crores for FY26.
updates.quote: last year, we have guided INR3,000 crores of revenue and end up INR2,700 crores. And in the beginning of the year, we guided at INR4,400 crores, now we are targeting INR4,100 crores.

updates.note: Management confirmed the OSAT facility at Sanand is now operational.
updates.quote: The OSAT facility at Sanand is now operational and steadily ramping up.

updates.note: Management discussed the PCB HDI multilayer PCB facility coming up at Chennai.
updates.quote: The new PCB HDI multilayer PCB facility coming up at Chennai gives us a strategic advantage.

updates.note: Management reiterated target of bringing net working capital to about 85 days by March '26.
updates.quote: So, you can expect about 85 days and better net working capital.

new_promises.statement: Achieve $1 billion in revenue by fiscal 2028.
new_promises.quote: you reiterated your $1 billion guidance for fiscal '28. So basically doubling from where you are right now
new_promises.speaker: Sameet Sinha / Ramesh Kunhikannan

new_promises.statement: Expected capex of about INR 400 crores to be spent in Q4 FY26.
new_promises.quote: I remember you saying INR400 crores will be spent in Q4. What would be the spend so far in 9 months?
new_promises.speaker: Viral Shah / Jairam Sampath
